capabilities: , Combines monthly calendar and day timeline
disambiguation: Not a full task database; it focuses on scheduling and time blocking within a single Markdown file.
extras: Does not include Google Calendar/ICS sync, time tracking, or Obsidian Tasks integration.
intentEvidence: A modified version of the Obsidian Calendar Plugin that keeps your schedule in one Markdown file instead of individual daily notes.
problem: The original Obsidian Calendar Plugin requires managing schedules across multiple individual daily notes, making centralized planning difficult.

relations.evidence: A modified version of the Obsidian Calendar Plugin that keeps your schedule in one Markdown file instead of individual daily notes.

summary: Calendar Planner is a modified version of the Obsidian Calendar Plugin that uses a single Markdown file to manage schedules across monthly, day, 3-day, and week timelines.
